whether you won: the relay settles matches in memory (`settleMatch`/`rankRoom` in
`multiplayer_server/src/index.js`) and `trivia.GameSession` stores only user/game/mode/score/duration

design round will reduce the rest to explicit steps.

downgrade steps to `[sonnet]` per 5d.
Consequences: the design round must decide who writes match outcomes (prefer the relay, never
client-claimed wins) and must scope "deep stats" to what the new record can actually answer; a
GameSession-only aggregate view is an acceptable first slice if it keeps the friends breakdown.
